## Validation and review

- [ ] Ran the validation commands in docs/RESEARCH_WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] Included any additional issue-specific checks (for market prompt edits: `python prompts/market/validate_prompts.py`)
- [ ] Checked claim-level evidence and dates; synthetic examples are not research findings
- [ ] Checked public files for private content and credential-bearing URLs
- [ ] Requested affected owners' review where a handoff or contract change requires it

Use `Refs #n` for partial research. Use `Closes #n` only when the issue's full acceptance criteria are met.

The issue's live assignee owns acceptance. CODEOWNERS routes file reviews; it does not reassign issues. Keep draft findings and unresolved handoffs explicit.
